hypotheses.construction_plan: Start with a two-argument kernel T(x,y). The member T(i,j) is the identity specialization x=i, y=j. The member T(j,i) is obtained from the same latent object by the argument permutation (x,y)->(y,x) and then specializing x=i, y=j. The observed expression is the sum of the identity member and the permuted member, i.e. an unnormalized S2 symmetrization of T.
required_assumptions: T is a function of two ordered arguments
i and j are valid argument labels
hypotheses.rationale: The raw expression sums T over the two possible orderings of the pair (i,j), which is exactly the structure of an unnormalized symmetrization of an arbitrary two-argument function.
